name: PiD student SDE and renoise family
plain: Distilled flow samplers: take x0, then re-noise to the next sigma with fresh noise (LCM form in flow). No derivative at all. Variants add think steps and a creative start.
math:
x=(1−σ′)x0+σ′·n·s_noise. σ′=0: x=x0.
Creative: at i=0, repeat think_steps: x0=model(x,t), x=lerp(x,(1−t)x0+t·ε,creative_strength).
DMAD renoise: same with _blend_renoise. LLaDa: same.

providers.author: Merserk
providers.note: _PiDStudentSDESampler class at pid_decode.py:653, head read only

label: from code
surprise: Core lcm uses noise_scaling; these hard-code (1−σ) flow form.

audit.note: In the TBG PiD samplers σ′ is not the incoming schedule: t_list comes from fixed PID_DISTILLED_TIMESTEPS, with sigmas used only for step count and a strength scale (Ltamann__ComfyUI-TBG-ETUR/py/nodes/UpscalerRefiner/inc/pid_sde_sampler_registry.py:24-43). Changing the scheduler shape has no effect there. The creative variant also has an extra early semantic step and early_noise_boost raising the renoise level on i<2 (lines 40-41, 139-141), both omitted. "LLaDa: same" lacks s_noise (T8mars__Comfyui-LLaDa-Image-T8/nodes.py:59).
